visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of a golden-brown, crispy pastry being pulled apart to reveal a thick, creamy pale-yellow custard filling. The background is a soft-focus wooden surface with warm lighting. (2) A transition leads to a top-down view of a black frying pan. A pair of hands pours white milk from a glass jar, followed by two eggs from a bowl. White cornstarch and sugar are sprinkled in, and condensed milk is scraped from a small glass bowl with a spoon. (3) A wire whisk is used to blend the ingredients into a smooth white liquid. The person's hand moves in a steady circular motion. (4) The pan is placed on a stove, and the whisking continues as the mixture begins to heat. The liquid slowly transforms into a lumpy, thick custard texture. (5) Using a pink silicone spatula, the thick custard is scooped from the pan and transferred into a large clear glass bowl. The background shows a clean kitchen counter. (6) On a pink silicone baking mat with circular measurements, a single flat, round dough disc (scallion pancake style) is laid out. Hands wearing transparent plastic gloves use the pink spatula to spread the yellow filling across the center of the dough. (7) A second dough disc is placed directly on top of the filling. The gloved hands press the edges firmly together to seal the two layers. (8) The edges are then meticulously folded and twisted in a braid-like pattern to create a decorative crust. (9) The assembled pastry is moved to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. A small brush is used to apply a yellow egg wash over the top. (10) A hand sprinkles white sesame seeds over the surface. The pie is then slid into a preheated oven with glowing orange heating elements. (11) The final shot returns to the close-up of the cooked, flaky pie, emphasizing its layered texture and the steaming, soft filling.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 奶油酥餅. [Logo]: wecook123. (2) [Slogan]: 牛奶 230g. [Slogan]: 雞蛋 2顆. [Slogan]: 玉米粉 35g. [Slogan]: 白糖 20g. [Slogan]: 煉乳 20g. (3) [Subtitle]: 將所有食材攪拌均勻. (4) [Subtitle]: 攪拌均勻後開火. (5) [Subtitle]: 一邊煮一邊攪拌 避免煮焦. (6) [Subtitle]: 煮至濃稠狀態 關火放涼備用. (7) [Subtitle]: 把食材舖在 1張抓餅上. (8) [Subtitle]: 用另一張抓餅 蓋在上面. (9) [Subtitle]: 把抓餅邊緣捲起. (10) [Subtitle]: 刷上一層 薄薄的蛋黃液. (11) [Subtitle]: 撒上少許白芝麻. (12) [Subtitle]: 烤箱溫度 200°C 15-20分鐘.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track featuring a steady 4/4 drum beat. An energetic male narrator introduces the recipe with high vocal arousal and clear articulation. (2) A distinct splashing sound is heard as milk hits the pan, followed by the sharp, crisp crack of eggshells. The narrator lists each ingredient with rhythmic timing that matches the music's tempo. (3) A metallic clinking sound occurs as a spoon hits the glass, followed by a continuous rhythmic scraping sound representing the wire whisk mixing the ingredients. (4) As the cooking process intensifies, the narrator's pitch rises to indicate excitement. A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound marks a shift in the visual sequence. (5) The crinkling sound of thin plastic gloves is clearly audible as the narrator explains the assembly process. Soft thuds represent the dough being pressed. (6) A sharp mechanical click sounds when the oven door opens. The BGM maintains its bright, major-key energy throughout. (7) The video concludes with the narrator using a friendly, rising intonation to sign off, accompanied by a final bright synthesizer chord.
